Rank 1 Technique

  • Ki Cost: 10 Ki
  • Casting Time: 1 Action
  • Prerequisites: Kamehameha or Kamekameha
  • Range: 10 Feet
  • Chargeable?: No
  • Duration: 1 Round
  • Type: Other

The user starts to charge what appears to be the Kamehameha but instead of a beam a small explosion of confetti shoots out. One target of your choice must make an Intellegence Saving Throw against your Omni or Beam Save DC, your choice, or be Stunned until the start of their next turn.
